speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What beyond being and non-being?
premises: Things run double — being, unbeing, the two-yoked course.
Leap it. To the Third — bow to wondrous Śambhu.
inference: Leap the pair; bow the Third.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Who is free?
premises: Gods, seers, men — this triple world unfree.
But free are they who live off Thee alone, O Free — Thy hangers-on.
inference: Freedom contagious: Thy dependents share Thy freedom.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What medicine?
premises: Thy body, gem-set with the whole world — remembering it.
The one medicine for existence-pain. Who hold it, sit easy.
inference: Remembrance medicates: world-gemmed body recollected.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Who is high Lord?
premises: Whose white parasol is the moon, lit with its own light.
Whose whisk is heaven-river's rush — He alone is high Lord.
inference: Moon-parasol, river-whisk: kingship proclaimed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What glance begged?
premises: Bright, cool, single, pure — like a moon-sliver.
Deal me a glance, Lord, any at all, nectar-flowing.
inference: One nectar-glance begged.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Why not sweet?
premises: Drops fallen from Thy knowing-bliss sea — these knowings.
Why, Lord, in my mouth not nectar-sweet, not lovely?
inference: Dryness interrogated: why don't sea-drops taste sweet?

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Whose hearts?
premises: Hearts undipped in Thy love-sap, Lord — whose are so, Master,
are heartless, nothing else: such are contempt's seat.
inference: Unmelted hearts sentenced contemptible.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Who holds powers?
premises: Whose heart has met with Thine, Lord —
he, he alone, holds the ruling Ladies' powers: their one high vessel.
inference: Heart-union vessels goddesses' powers.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What floods?
premises: Drowner of joys, then sorrows — all, alike.
Thy thought-nectar in flood, over low ground, as water seeks it.
inference: Meditation floods high and low alike.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What do unparted eyes hold?
premises: What would their eyes not hold, brimmed with joy-stores —
they who, by more than life, Lord, nowhere ever leave Thee?
inference: Never-parted eyes brim with joy-stores.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of arrival?
premises: I thunder — ah! — I dance: my mind-chariots ride full,
for my Master is won — since Thou utterly delightest.
inference: Arrival roared and danced: Master won.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What else is there?
premises: No other known for doing, no other yoke for knowing.
And yet, what of knowing? Thou — all-one-full Knowing — unfoldest.
inference: Others cancelled: only all-one Knowing unfolds.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What routs pain?
premises: Hard, endless pains — suddenly out of their grip, fled.
From whom? Those in whose speech rings ever the Śiva-din.
inference: Śiva-din in speech routs hard pains.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Is there another?
premises: Is there another high One, marked by remaining Thine?
Thou alone art the great Person — shelter of persons, none left out.
inference: No second Person: sole shelter proclaimed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of His slaves?
premises: They win — Thy slaves, honored by the world, O world-pervader.
For whom this very passing-sea is a play-lake.
inference: Slaves win: ocean shrunk to play-lake.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of miseries?
premises: Let other miseries sit a while.
Here, for Thy partakers, appear plain, Thou — by that alone they are shamed.
inference: Manifestation shames miseries.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of beads?
premises: 'Naught beyond me' — yet even there I tell my beads, one with that.
In truth: 'murmur on' — with bead-strand Thou pointest onward.
inference: Beads told inside supremacy; onward pointed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What is He — being, unbeing?
premises: From being, needs must, highest being — and being past even that, Lord.
And Thou — other than being, other than unbeing — so art Thou being-unbeing-stuff.
inference: Knot tied: other than both, stuff of both.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Why unseen?
premises: Purer-bright than a thousand suns raying up.
Yet Thou, though through all worlds spread, art not seen.
inference: Unseen brightness: spread yet hidden.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Where is the knower?
premises: Knowing-shaped in the dead world, they say.
Knower inside the known; mighty in the measured: since Thou art so — highest of all, Lord.
inference: Knower found inside the known.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What remains to cry?
premises: Enough of other wailings — just this, before the Lord: I keen aloud.
For, Lord, I swoon, knowing even so.
inference: Close: keen and swoon in knowing.
